description: aurelius: session registration, skill index and database backup at session start, action trace after tool use, judge and reminder delivery on stop, reminder delivery on prompt submit too, a memory hint (decisions, problems, solutions naming the file) before the first edit of each file in a session. Every command is the au binary from PATH. Reminders are wired to BOTH Stop and UserPromptSubmit on purpose, not by oversight: Stop delivers at the end of a turn, UserPromptSubmit delivers the moment the owner types, and whichever fires first wins reminders::mark_delivered's conditional UPDATE — the other one finds the row already taken and says nothing, so registering both costs nothing and halves the wait for a reminder that matured mid-turn.
